SD14.description: Supplementary Data 14: genes identified by SMR (Westra et al. blood eQTL) using the GWAS meta-analysis including all endometriosis cases; one top SNP per probe.

Sapkota2017-1.notes: SMR top cis-eQTL (Westra 2013 peripheral-blood eQTL) from Supplementary Data 14, the SMR table for the GWAS meta-analysis including all endometriosis cases. The footnote calls RA the risk allele, but it is the SMR effect allele for both BETA (GWAS) and b_eQTL (BETA is negative for VEZT); RAF is its frequency. BETA / b_eQTL reproduces the table's b_SMR. Top SNP rs2268177.
